headline: Greek prime minister presents plan to raise wages before elections: minimum wage of 950 euros
summary: The measures would cost €2.2 billion in 2027, about 1% of GDP. They include a €950 minimum wage, a €400 annual pensioner bonus and income tax abolition for low-income farmers.
why: Fiscal measures of this size affect government deficits, public debt trajectories and Greek government bond spreads.
